# Brain Preflight

> Free iPhone app for aptitude test practice: mental arithmetic, logic, memory, spatial reasoning, divided attention and psychomotor tracking. 5 free sessions every day, on any exercise, with no purchase or subscription. Optional paid Premium adds unlimited sessions, mock exams and detailed diagnostics.

Brain Preflight is an independent app, not affiliated with any recruiter or test publisher. It practises related skills; it does not reproduce official tests, and app scores do not convert into official scores. The catalogue has 20 exercises in French, 19 in English and 15 in German, Spanish and Dutch. The guides below (46 articles) explain each selection from official sources and say which exercises fit and what the app does not cover.

## App

- [Brain Preflight on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6794363864): iPhone app, free download, 5 free sessions every day
- [Homepage](https://aakk91.github.io/): overview of the app and its training programmes
- [All guides](https://aakk91.github.io/guides/): index of every preparation guide
